summary: The legal contract has exactly 240 input pairs, so the Accepted on-demand palindrome generator cannot be scaled beyond its source domain for an honest asymptotic runtime verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: k is an integer from 2 through 9 and n is an integer from 1 through 30

replacement_checks.evidence: The exact Accepted algorithm enumerates ordered decimal palindromes, tests at most a finite contract-bounded prefix, and stops after at most thirty matches.
The certificate regression checks all 240 legal pairs against independently verified expected sums while the package cases exercise the exact on-demand generator.
